ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-contrast distribution approximately 70% high-intensity white pixels and 30% low-intensity black/dark-gray pixels.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Contiguous white pigmentation across the lobe interiors. Dense black mottling and streaking concentrated at the median notch and along the trailing edge boundary. Significant isolated black circular spot on the right lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped depression with a calculated interior angle of approximately 50 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency jagged serrations along the entire trailing edge; peak-to-valley amplitude is most pronounced on the outer thirds of both lobes, transitioning to smoother topography near the notch.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curvature originating from the median notch, tapering to sharp distal tips with an upward sweep.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Clusters of high-intensity white circular pixel nodes (barnacles) visible on the distal tips of both lobes; approx 7-10 distinct nodes per tip.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Multiple dark, unaligned linear pixel disruptions (rake marks). Notable parallel diagonal scratches on the right lobe and scattered multidirectional scratches on the left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive linear rake marks across both ventral surfaces and barnacle colonization on the lateral margins.
other_distinctive_markers: A singular, large, well-defined circular black pigmentation spot (macula) located in the lower-middle quadrant of the right lobe.
